title: Graphics & XR Engineer
tagline: Render worlds in real time: shaders, GPUs, AR and VR.
about: Graphics engineers write the code that turns geometry, light and materials into pixels in milliseconds, for games, film tools, maps, design software and augmented/virtual reality. XR engineers apply that to headsets and phones, where comfort and frame rate are critical.
It's maths-heavy (linear algebra above all) and visually rewarding.
